llm_response.reason: The domain 'vzw-offers-dnv.cc' mimics the Verizon Wireless brand (using 'vzw'), claims to offer promotions, and uses a suspicious TLD (.cc). The landing page shows irrelevant or cloaked content (generic Google navigation in Japanese), likely to hide the real malicious purpose from detection. The WHOIS data is intentionally hidden, preventing verification of any real company details. There is no proper business contact, legitimate branding, or indication of an active business. These characteristics match multiple scam criteria: spoofing a legitimate company, ambiguous information, obfuscation tactics, and no verifiable contact info.
